description: Experts are artifact-linked authors, not an exhaustive or ranked social directory.
Metric conflicts, local legal authority and harmed-party review cannot be resolved by a generic model family.
Candidate contracts do not yet encode every theorem precondition and finite-sample guarantee for every method variant.
Some predictive architectures use autoregressive or pretraining mechanics; generative product/agent semantics remain quarantined and require separate modeling.
Innovation records are artifact-scoped candidates; publication date and benchmark result do not establish production value.
The universe is open; no fixed list proves all future predictive methods, targets or representations are covered.
Qualification profiles are templates; no deployed package/version/target receives a pass from this corpus.
Complexity is contractually required but exact resource envelopes remain provider/shape/target measurements.
Four examples are falsification pilots, not complete industry applicability matrices.
